text:
maya (SDK): Heads-up — my SDK PR is ready but blocked on two things:
1) API contract change in PR #452 (samir) needs a quick look/approval
2) Helm chart bump + runtime shim (kevin / jen) for the new feature.
Can folks signal availability for a short unblock review window today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir (API): on it. I saw the contract diff, left one comment about optional field naming. I'll push a small update in a bit.

maya (SDK): thanks — the optional field is backwards-compatible, but codegen needs the exact name. If you approve after your change, I can re-run codegen and push a follow-up.

kevin (Console): I can take the helm bump/values diff. quick Q: does SDK depend on chart image tag or runtime config change?

maya (SDK): image tag only (new arg to start svc: REDWOOD_NEW_FEATURE=true). No API path changes. Example helm snippet:
```yaml
image:
  tag: "v1.12.0-sdk-feature"
env:
  - name: REDWOOD_NEW_FEATURE
    value: "true"
```

kevin (Console): perfect. I can do the chart PR once samir approves API and maya pushes the regenerated client. Toss me the PR link when ready.

jen (Infra): FYI CI flaky job (helm-lint) is throwing a transient error this morning, saw it in other jobs. If your helm PR hits the lint flake, ping and I'll re-run the infra job.

ci-bot: Build queued: sdk-ci/452 — running unit tests.

maya (SDK): pushed codegen update and link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/452/commits/3f2a
samir (API): reviewed and approved the contract rename — tiny nit fixed. LGTM.

ci-bot: sdk-ci/452 passed all checks.

kevin (Console): opened helm PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/118 — includes tag bump + values change. Marked @jen for infra re-run if lint flakes.

maya (SDK): thanks all — marking this thread resolved once charts PR merges. Anyone else need to be looped in?

samir (API): all good from API side. :thumbsup:

jen (Infra): monitoring lint — will rerun if it flakes. otherwise approved from infra.

kevin (Console): will merge after one final e2e smoke (10m).

maya (SDK): awesome, will queue the release after merge. Thanks everyone!
